message: OIDC access is now driven by the identity provider's client roles instead of groups. In BASEROW_OIDC_PROVIDERS, groups_claim, staff_groups and superuser_groups become roles_claim, staff_roles and superuser_roles, and a workspace_mappings entry now takes client_role plus permissions (ADMIN or MEMBER) instead of group and role. roles_claim defaults to Keycloak's resource_access.${client_id}.roles and accepts a dotted path, so nested claims resolve. A provider that maps any client role now refuses to sign in, and refuses to provision, a user holding none of them. The retired keys are rejected at startup with the name of their replacement.
